summary_en: Marubun raised its FY2027 year-end dividend forecast by 23 yen to 62 yen per share, bringing the full-year dividend to 100 yen per share with an estimated payout ratio of 50.5%. The increase follows an upward revision of consolidated earnings guidance.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Dividend Forecast (Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Marubun Corporation announced on October 30, 2026, a revision of its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The company raised the year-end dividend forecast from the previously announced 39 yen per share to 62 yen per share, an increase of 23 yen. Combined with the interim dividend of 38 yen already paid, the full-year dividend is now forecast at 100 yen per share, compared to the prior forecast of 77 yen per share.

The revision follows an upward adjustment to consolidated earnings guidance announced on the same day. The company operates under a dividend policy targeting either a consolidated payout ratio of 50% or a dividend on equity (DOE) of 3.5%, whichever is higher. Based on this policy framework and the improved earnings outlook, the revised year-end dividend of 62 yen per share is expected to result in a consolidated payout ratio of 50.5% for the full fiscal year.

The company emphasized that shareholder returns remain a key management priority and commits to continuing stable and sustainable dividend payments under this dividend framework.
